summary.zh: Orbit-AL · 再入金属环境监测

description.zh: EPFL 2026 的 Orbit-AL 项目面向航天器再入产生的含铝、铁平流层气溶胶，提出气球采样、分级浸取与化学分析及生物传感相结合的监测路线。项目计划在地面至 30 km 高度采样，以 ICP-MS 和工程大肠杆菌传感器比较金属的浸取行为与细胞可利用性，获得由实验操作定义的金属可接近比例、Fe(II)/Fe(III) 比值及生物可利用比例。团队希望这些数据用于大气模型、模拟颗粒制备及再入环境影响评估，并检验化学浸取能否代表再入铁的生物摄取。
description.en: Orbit-AL by EPFL 2026 proposes monitoring aluminium- and iron-bearing stratospheric aerosols from spacecraft re-entry through balloon sampling, differential extraction, chemical analysis and biosensing. The project targets sampling from the ground to 30 km, comparing metal leaching with cellular accessibility using ICP-MS and engineered E. coli sensors. Intended outputs include operationally defined accessible metal fractions, Fe(II)/Fe(III) ratios and bioavailable fractions. The team aims to inform atmospheric models, analogue-particle preparation and re-entry environmental assessment, and to test whether chemical leaching represents biological uptake of re-entry iron.
